issues.detail: The skill is vendor-locked to Apple Silicon Macs and cannot run on other platforms.

scenarios.name: ci-xcode-build

scenarios.name: custom-linux-build-and-push
scenarios.rationale: Response B follows most of the required tart workflow but omits the mandatory `tart create` step, whereas Response A does not use tart at all.
